title: Creatio Presents Bank.AI Summit Agenda, Featuring Research Analyst Alyson Clarke
summary: The October 27 in-person event will bring banking and credit union leaders together to explore AI applications across growth, customer service, and governance
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together—with no limits on users, agents, or scale — announced the agenda for[Bank.AI Summit by Creatio](https://www.bank.ai/page/bank-ai-summit-chicago) , taking place on October 27, 2026, at the Four Seasons Hotel Chicago. The event will bring together financial services leaders, AI experts, and technology innovators to explore how banks and credit unions can benefit from the AI revolution.


Alyson Clarke, Principal Analyst at Forrester, will join the Summit as a featured speaker, delivering a thought-leadership session on the state of AI adoption in financial services. The session will offer a strategic look at the forces shaping the future of AI in banking and the decisions financial institutions need to consider as they navigate this rapidly evolving landscape.


The Summit will open with a visionary keynote from Katherine Kostereva, CEO of Creatio, on building the agentic bank of the future, followed by a product keynote exploring the Creatio Bank.AI operating model across Growth, Service, and Operations.


From there onwards, attendees will be able to choose from four dedicated tracks, Grow, Serve, Governance, and Expo Product Showcase designed to address some of the most important questions financial institutions face as they implement AI:


- **Grow** track will explore how an agent fleet can help grow financial institutions, drive referrals, and reinvent customer onboarding
- **Serve** track will focus on AI-powered customer service, from automating complex workflows to delivering excellent customer experiences 24/7
- **Governance** track will address the foundations for scaling AI securely and responsibly, including governance, observability, data readiness, and risk management
- **Expo Product Showcase** track will feature live Bank.AI demos and solution spotlights, showcasing AI agent use cases across marketing and sales and providing guidance on monitoring AI performance and orchestrating AI across chat, voice, and video


Throughout the day, attendees will hear directly from industry leaders through customer success stories, fireside chats, best-practice sessions, panel discussions, and hands-on workshops. Speakers from Nasdaq, Lake City Bank, Cape & Coast Bank, Trumark Credit Union, United Federal Credit Union, and other financial organizations will share perspectives and experiences from across the industry. Additionally, Bank.AI Summit will provide opportunities for executives to connect with peers, exchange ideas, and explore the latest AI innovations for financial services through live demos.


Registration is now open.


Explore the full agenda and register: https://www.bank.ai/page/bank-ai-summit-chicago
